description: Integration module to wire snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) into approval_workflow on :8780. Reads from mcp_submissions table for ServiceNow inbound ticket data. On new submission: (1) query snow_connector for ticket status, (2) if ticket approved, trigger approval_workflow.create_decision(), (3) write result back to mcp_decisions. Must NOT introduce HTTP between peer daemons — all via write_service :8772. Snow connector exists and is protected; this is the wiring layer only. Priority 0.85 because integration is blocking Phase 9 enterprise use case.
